title: 医用工学
subtitle: Medical Engineering
keywords: Electronic circuit 2.Biosignal measurement 3.Medical measuring instrument 4.Biomaterial analysis 5.Safety measure
educationalGoal: Engineering plays an extremely important role in the medical field. Medical engineering is the application of engineering principles and design concepts to medicine and is indispensable for medical diagnosis and treatment. This course aims to help students understand how these principles are applied to diagnostic devices and treatment devices that are actually used in the medical field. Students also learn about safety measures for the human body in diagnosis and treatment.
advice: The course will provide information which should enable the student to explain: 1. Historical views of medical engineering. 2. Cutting edge medical engineering equipment. 3. Bioelectric measurement (intracellular recording, extracellular recording, EEG, etc.). 4. Analog signal processing (current, voltage, resistance, AC, DC, passive circuit elements). 5. Operational amplifiers (negative resistive feedback, imaginary short). 6. Filter circuits and frequency response (low pass filter, high pass filter). 7. Electric shock and leakage (ground, earth). 8. Digital signal processing (transistors, binary logic, TTL). 9. Computer architecture and programming (information theory, units of information, assembly language). 10. Temporal and spatial resolution (analog-to-digital conversion, sampling frequency). 11. Medical imaging and nuclear medicine (computed tomography (CT), magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), positron emission tomography (PET), etc.). 12. Mechanisms of cancer and treatments (radiation therapy, chemotherapy, immunotherapy, etc.). 13. Separation and analysis of biological materials (high performance liquid chromatography). 14. Analysis of brain hormone using HPLC-ECD (biogenic amines, electrochemical detection). 15. Artificial intelligence in medicine (machine learning for medical diagnostics, robotic surgical systems).
requiredKnowledge: General knowledge of physics and chemistry are required. In order to understand knowledge and laws, the habit of learning the history from which they were obtained is required.
